items.summary: Approve containment-only execution. Preserve the deferred SEO, UX, accessibility, performance, content, attribution, audience, and monetization backlog. Continue only existing failure repair-or-close, period-aligned measurement reconciliation, and bounded read-only legal/security evidence. Do not create or requeue production work, experiments, telemetry, dependencies, spend, deployments, monetization changes, or external outreach. Keep the gated product private until rights, privacy, security, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates are complete.

Reconsider queue entry only after retained failures have documented ownership, root cause, isolated validation, rollback, and deduplication; measurement capacity and security, attribution, and financial gates must also be satisfied. Existing technical and revenue signals do not establish causal lift, ROI, margin, or readiness for new production work.
